title: Complete platform endpoint tool exports baseline before migration 062

phases.objective: Define the platform endpoint export registry in the canonical schema before migration 062 creates diagnostic views and later migrations perform export upserts.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact local Git checkout applies schema.sql and the ordered migration chain in disposable MariaDB.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Migration 062 can create views over platform_endpoint_tool_exports, and later export migrations can insert/update deterministic contract metadata without unknown-table failures.
steps: The canonical baseline defines export identity, endpoint/action binding, tool/scope/status, tenant scope, source endpoint, JSON policy/schema fields, notes, and timestamps.
The manifest declares platform_endpoint_tool_exports as a required runtime support table and validates its baseline column contract.
The generator checks table and column presence before MariaDB replay and emits the contract in plan evidence.
Runtime listing and dispatch consumers can filter active exports by tenant and scope without reading secret payloads.
No provider access, Production mutation, data copy, or plaintext secret is introduced.
assertions: schema.sql contains platform_endpoint_tool_exports before the migration chain.
Migration 062 can create its diagnostic view against the baseline table.
The generator fails closed when the table or required column is absent.
The runtime support contract includes platform_endpoint_tool_exports.
The regression suite covers first-use ordering and plan evidence.
